match.verdict: Consistent with a cold brown dwarf, type T5 to T7 (best match T6).
match.method: Chi-square fits of the SPIFF brown-dwarf templates (Gagné et al., arXiv:2604.22012) and of non-brown-dwarf comparisons (reddened stars, dust, power laws, star plus dust), compared by an information criterion on rescaled chi-square, with a goodness-of-fit gate and a check that the template's molecular bands are actually seen.

per_pass.label: Apr 2025
per_pass.reason: SPHEREx detects the object at only 5 wavelengths (1.0 to 3.8 µm), which is too little of the spectrum to classify it.

pass_agreement.sentence: All 2 passes typed on their own agree (1 too faint to type alone).

warnings: Catalogue frame-quality scores were unavailable for the WISE frames from 2010 (cryogenic), 2010-2011 (post-cryogenic), so those frames were checked by their measured pixel noise instead.
1 of 285 SPHEREx spectrum points are left out (1 where too much of the target is covered by bad pixels).
The Gaia DR3 and CatWISE2020 lists were reused from the view built on 15 Nov 2026, because the catalogue services did not answer.
